description: This file contains unit tests for the MiniLang framework within the OFBiz project. It defines the class MiniLangTests which extends OFBizTestCase and includes multiple test methods that verify the functionality of simple methods, assignment operators, error checks, and result handling in the mini-language used by OFBiz.

classes.name: MiniLangTests
classes.description: JUnit test class for the MiniLang framework, testing various operators and functionalities of SimpleMethod within OFBiz.

methods.name: testAssignmentOperators
methods.description: Tests the assignment operators, error checks, and assertions in the mini-language.

methods.name: testFieldToResultOperation
methods.description: Verifies field-to-result operation functionality within a simple method execution.
